name: Wyrm, Forest
body:
Forest Wyrm CR 8

XP 4,800
CE Huge dragon (earth)
Init +5; Senses darkvision 80 ft., low-light vision; Perception +18

DEFENSE

AC 19, touch 9, flat-footed 17 (+1 Dex, +9 natural, –2 size)
hp 104 (9d12+45)
Fort +9, Ref +6, Will +8
Immune sleep, paralysis

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., swim 20 ft.
Melee bite +16 (2d8+8 plus poison), slam +16 (1d8+8)
Space 20 ft.; Reach 10 ft.

STATISTICS

Str 27; Dex 12; Con 18; Int 9; Wis 12; Cha 9
Base Atk +8; CMB +13 (+17 grapple); CMD 24
Feats Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Skill Focus (Perception), Improved Natural Armor, Improved Natural Attack
Skills Perception +18, Sense Motive +10, Stealth +10; Racial Modifiers +4 Perception
Languages Draconic

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Poison (Ex)

Bite—injury; save DC 20; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d6 Constitution damage; cure 2 consecutive saves. The save DC is Constitution-based.

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate or cold forests or wetlands
Organization solitary, pair, or swarm (3-6)
Treasure double

Forest wyrms are pungent, strong-scented dragon-kin related to wyverns. While cunning, forest wyrms are malicious and brutal, and will almost always attack sentient beings within their territory. Forest wyrms can speak Draconic, but actually successfully speaking with forest wyrms is very rare. The forest wyrm’s diet consists of at least 100 pounds of fresh or carrion meat a day.

Forest wyrms are territorial over their forest domain, and are constantly traveling throughout the forest to both hunt and guard their land. A typical forest wyrm’s hunting territory can be over 60 square miles of forest.

A full-grown forest wyrm is about 40 feet in length, and weighs 4,500 pounds. They are dark in coloration, have ridges running the length of their worm-like body, and have a huge crushing maw.
